provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: CDM includes 22 amino acids, 11 vitamins, 3 nucleobases, 8 inorganic salts, and glucose [Table 1: Deionized H2O; Iron 0.006; Phosphate 18.3; MgSO4.7H2O 0.7; ... coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components).
